safeguards.name: Minimum Available Disk Space (1 GiB)
safeguards.simulatedScenario: Simulated disk space < 1 GiB throws SAFE_CHECK_FAILED

safeguards.name: Minimum Available RAM (150 MB)
safeguards.simulatedScenario: Simulated available RAM < 150 MB throws SAFE_CHECK_FAILED

safeguards.name: Disk / RAM Query Exception Handling
safeguards.simulatedScenario: statfs returning ENOENT or permission denied throws SAFE_CHECK_FAILED (no optimistic pass)

safeguards.name: Per-Gate Log Buffer Cap (50 MB)
safeguards.simulatedScenario: Stream exceeding 50 MB triggers child termination and gate fail

safeguards.name: Worktree Immutability Check (Pre and Post Execution)
safeguards.simulatedScenario: HEAD or tree change during execution is caught immediately by verifyWorktreeIntegrity

safeguards.name: Process Group Signal Termination
safeguards.simulatedScenario: Child processes spawned with detached:true are terminated using negative PID group kill (-pid)

safeguards.name: Serialized SQLite Access Pipeline (E5 -> E8 -> E9)
safeguards.simulatedScenario: Integration tests, backtest replay, and candidate DB readback are sequenced strictly to eliminate SQLite locking errors

safeguards.name: Typed Gate Output Validators (Vitest, Backtest, DB Readback, CI Diagnostic)
safeguards.simulatedScenario: Non-zero test failures, count arithmetic mismatch, malformed JSON, or false provider assertions rejected fail-closed
